passives.name: Pretending to be Master ★
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken effect to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). At the start of the turn, inflicts Bleeding on a random enemy that ignores Resilience and Immunity for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000025_4_1] turn(s). At the end of the caster's turn, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000025_4_2].
